faq.label: DOGO HELP CENTER
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about shopping with DOGO.
faq.orderQuestion: How can I place an order?
faq.orderAnswer: Choose the product and size you want and follow the steps to complete your order.
faq.deliveryAnswer: The standard delivery time is 1 to 3 business days after order confirmation. Orders within Bulgaria are delivered by Econt or Speedy to your address or to a convenient courier office.
faq.returnQuestion: Can I return or exchange a product?
faq.returnAnswer: Yes. You can return a product within 14 calendar days from the date of delivery. A size or model can be exchanged within 14 days of receiving the order, provided that the product meets the conditions for being returned in its original condition.
faq.paymentAnswer: Information about the available payment methods will be added soon.
faq.sizeQuestion: How do I choose the correct size?
faq.sizeAnswer: Measure your foot from the heel to the longest toe. For standard models, it is recommended to add approximately 1 cm to the measured length. Please note that sizing may vary depending on the specific model.

about.label: DOGO BULGARIA
about.title: Welcome to the world of DOGO Bulgaria!
about.intro: We believe that fashion is more than just clothing – it is a canvas for self-expression, a story you tell the world, and a choice made in harmony with nature.
about.storyTitle: How It All Began: The World's First
about.storyOne: As the official representative of DOGO in Bulgaria, our mission is to bring this colorful revolution to our streets and offer Bulgarian art lovers inspiring shoes and accessories.
about.storyTwo: Founded in 2006 in beautiful Izmir, Turkey, DOGO became a global pioneer as the first company to create unique and durable digital prints on eco-leather shoes. It all began with one bold idea: to transform an ordinary shoe into a moving work of art.
about.veganTitle: 100% Vegan and Caring for the Planet
about.veganIntro: At DOGO Bulgaria, ethical fashion is a cause we believe in. We do not use materials of animal origin.
about.veganProducts: 100% Vegan: All our products are certified vegan.
about.sustainability: Sustainability: We use high-quality eco-leather, certified cotton linings, and recyclable materials.
about.safeColors: Safe Colors: Our unique prints are created using environmentally friendly, solvent-free inks that are safe for both people and nature.
about.styleText: DOGO products are created for people who are not afraid to stand out. Every design carries an emotion – from classic literary themes and retro illustrations to modern urban graphics and playful animal prints. When you wear DOGO, you are not simply wearing shoes – you are expressing your individuality, sense of humor, and love of art.
about.whyTitle: Why Shop from the Official Bulgarian Website?
about.originalProducts: 100% original products directly from the DOGO factory.
about.collections: Exclusive access to the latest limited collections.
about.fastDelivery: Fast delivery throughout Bulgaria with an inspection and try-on option.
about.customerService: Professional customer service in Bulgarian, ready to assist you with any questions or size exchanges.
about.closing: Thank you for being part of our colorful family and choosing to step forward with kindness and style!

delivery.label: DOGO BULGARIA
delivery.title: Order and Delivery
delivery.intro: At DOGO Bulgaria, we aim to provide you with a fast, convenient and secure shopping experience. All DOGO shoes and bags are delivered with care throughout Bulgaria.
delivery.courierText: All orders within Bulgaria are delivered by Speedy – either to a selected Speedy office or directly to your address.
delivery.timeText: All orders are processed and dispatched within 2 to 4 business days, provided that the items are available in stock.
delivery.freeDeliveryText: Delivery is free for all orders over EUR 100. For orders under EUR 100, delivery costs are paid by the customer according to Speedy's standard rates.
delivery.confirmationText: After placing an order, a member of our team will contact you by phone to confirm product availability and delivery details. Orders are not dispatched without telephone confirmation.
delivery.availabilityText: If a product is temporarily out of stock but a new delivery from the DOGO factory is expected, our team will contact you by phone and inform you when the order can be fulfilled.
delivery.testText: All shipments include a free Open and Try option, allowing you to inspect and try the product in the presence of the courier before payment.

return.label: DOGO BULGARIA
return.title: Exchange and Returns
return.intro: We understand that choosing shoes and bags online requires flexibility, so we offer a simple and convenient exchange and return process.
return.exchangeText: If, after trying the shoes at home, you find that you need a different size or would like to exchange them for another model, you may do so within 14 calendar days from the date of receipt.
return.conditionProduct: The product must be in its original saleable condition – it must not have been worn outdoors, damaged, washed or cleaned.
return.conditionBox: It is recommended that shoes are returned in their original box, placed inside additional protective packaging or a bag to prevent damage during transport.
return.conditionLabels: Please do not remove any labels until you are sure that the product and size are suitable for you.
return.exchangeShipping: The cost of returning the product and delivering the new size or model is paid by the customer according to the courier's standard rates.
return.exchangeRequest: Request an exchange and specify the new size or model you would like to receive.
return.exchangeSend: After submitting your request, send the product back to us via Speedy courier.
return.exchangeConfirmation: Once we receive the product and confirm that it is in its original saleable condition, we will send you the selected new size or model.
return.returnText: Under Bulgarian consumer legislation, you have the right to withdraw from your purchase and return the product within 14 calendar days from the date of receipt without providing a reason.
return.returnCondition: Make sure the product is in its original saleable condition and shows no signs of outdoor use or improper treatment.
return.contactUs: Submit your return request according to the specified return procedure.
return.sendBack: Send the product back via Speedy courier without cash on delivery. Return shipping costs are paid by the customer.
return.requiredDocumentsText: The product must be accompanied by proof of purchase. For cash-on-delivery payments made through Speedy, please include the original Postal Money Transfer receipt or a clear copy with the returned product.
return.refundText: After we receive and inspect the returned product, the amount paid will be refunded by bank transfer to the IBAN provided by you. The standard processing time is 7–8 business days, with the stated maximum period being up to 14 calendar days.
return.closing: If you experience any difficulties or have questions about an exchange or return, our team is available to assist you.

privacy.label: DOGO BULGARIA
privacy.title: Privacy and Confidentiality Policy
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is important to us. This policy provides information about the collection, use, storage and protection of personal data when using our online store.
privacy.administratorText: The personal data controller is Victris Ltd., UIC 201571356, VAT No. BG201571356, with registered office and management address at 8 Perushtitsa Street, Burgas, Bulgaria.
privacy.dataTitle: What personal data do we collect?
privacy.dataIntro: Depending on how you use the online store, the following categories of personal data may be processed:
privacy.dataIdentity: Identification data – first and last name.
privacy.dataContact: Contact details – telephone number, email address and delivery address.
privacy.dataOrder: Information related to your orders, selected products, delivery and payment method.
privacy.dataTechnical: Technical data related to the use of the website, where such data is collected through the technologies and services used.
privacy.purposeTitle: Why do we use your personal data?
privacy.purposeOrders: To receive, process and fulfil your orders.
privacy.purposeDelivery: To arrange and complete the delivery of purchased products.
privacy.purposeCommunication: To communicate with you regarding orders, enquiries and customer service.
privacy.purposeLegal: To comply with legal and accounting obligations.
privacy.purposeMarketing: To send marketing communications where you have provided the required consent.
privacy.paymentText: When paying by bank card, your card details are entered only on the secure payment page of the relevant bank or card operator. The online store and Victris Ltd. do not collect, store or process your bank card details.
privacy.recipientsTitle: Who may receive your personal data?
privacy.recipientsIntro: Where necessary to fulfil an order or comply with legal obligations, personal data may be provided to:
privacy.recipientCourier: Courier companies required to deliver your order.
privacy.recipientPayment: Banks and payment service providers in connection with payment processing.
privacy.recipientIT: IT, hosting and other technical service providers required for the operation of the online store.
privacy.recipientAuthorities: Competent public authorities where disclosure of information is required by law.
privacy.rightAccess: The right to access your personal data.
privacy.rightCorrection: The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
privacy.rightDeletion: The right to request deletion of your personal data where the legal requirements are met.
privacy.rightRestriction: The right to request restriction of processing in cases provided by law.
privacy.rightObjection: The right to object to the processing of your personal data where applicable.
privacy.rightPortability: The right to data portability in cases provided by law.
privacy.complaintText: If you believe that your rights regarding the protection of personal data have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP).

terms.merchantText: The merchant and operator of the online store is Victris Ltd., UIC 201571356, VAT No. BG201571356, with registered office and management address at 8 Perushtitsa Street, Burgas, Bulgaria.
terms.productsText: The online store offers products under the DOGO brand. Product prices are displayed in euros (EUR) and represent the final retail prices of the goods.
